explanation_full: Observationally, the SVM model achieved an R2 score of 0.7324, with a correlation of 0.86576 between predicted and actual values. The Mean Absolute Error (MAE) was 0.0946, and the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) was 0.1369. These metrics suggest a generally good fit, though the maximum absolute residual was 0.610181, suggesting some variability in predictions. These findings are based solely on the scatter plot diagnostics.
